statements.subject: dccp
statements.description: The use of this feature is NOT RECOMMENDED.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: A DCCP stack MAY therefore leave the ECN Incapable feature unimplemented, acting as if all connections were ECN capable.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: DCCP A MUST be able to read ECN bits from received frames' IP headers when ECN Incapable/A is zero.
actions: Read ECN bits from received frames' IP headers

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If the ECN Incapable/A feature is one, then all of DCCP B's packets MUST be sent as ECN incapable.
actions: Send all packets as ECN incapable

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If a DCCP is not ECN capable, it MUST send Mandatory "Change L(ECN Incapable, 1)" options to the other endpoint until acknowledged (by "Confirm R(ECN Incapable, 1)") or the connection closes.
statements.pre_cond: endpoint.ecn_capable = false & peer.ecn_incapable_confirmed = false & connection.state != CLOSED
actions: Send Mandatory Change L(ECN Incapable, 1) option to peer
Repeat until Confirm R(ECN Incapable, 1) received or connection closes

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Furthermore, it MUST NOT accept any data until the other endpoint sends "Confirm R(ECN Incapable, 1)".

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: It SHOULD send Data Dropped options on its acknowledgements, with Drop Code 0 ("protocol constraints"), if the other endpoint does send data inappropriately.
statements.pre_cond: endpoint.ecn_capable = false & peer.ecn_incapable_confirmed = false & peer.sent_data = true
actions: Include Data Dropped option with Drop Code 0 (protocol constraints) in outgoing acknowledgements
